title: Siege of Padua
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Padua", at revision 1370744265, opens: "The siege of Padua was a major engagement early in the War of the League of Cambrai." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2284174, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1509 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
